status: frozen before any v7 model code was written and before any holdout evaluation
source: engineering HIL accuracy requirements; thresholds carried over unchanged from gates_v63.json so the bar is not lowered

space_heating_suite.scored_samples: 10 s samples from the end of the 30-min warm-up to block end, with fresh measured T_incoming (age <= 900 s), excluding every DHW window [ww rise, ww fall + 600 s]

dhw_suite.episodes: all HO-* blocks with at least one circulating DHW event
dhw_suite.circulating_dhw_event: ww rising edge with bp > 0 and ww = 0 during at least one of the preceding 10 one-minute samples and a secondary pump on (same definition as select_holdout_v7.py)
dhw_suite.window: [ww rise, ww fall + 600 s] for every circulating DHW event; union per episode
dhw_suite.change_vs_v63: v6.3 scored only [ww fall, ww fall + 600 s] of any ww edge, including DHW cycles during idle where T_incoming is flat and R2 is undefined in practice. v7 scores the whole divert + recovery of circulating DHW events, which is what the HIL controller must see (integrator freeze, plunge, recovery).

rules: Gates and holdout are hashed in freeze_v7.json and committed before model work.
The holdout is evaluated exactly once, after the parameter freeze.
Any FAIL is reported as FAIL; no post-hoc retuning on holdout data.
